headword: {岩倉使節団|いわくらしせつだん}

definitions.explanation: The Meiji government's embassy to the United States and Europe from 1871 to 1873, led by Iwakura Tomomi. It tried to revise the unequal treaties and studied Western government, industry and education.

examples.japanese: {岩倉使節団|いわくらしせつだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欧米|おうべい}→欧米：04112_oubei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: The Iwakura Mission toured America and Europe.

examples.japanese: {岩倉使節団|いわくらしせつだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同行|どうこう}した→同行する：21427_doukousuru⟧。
examples.english: Young students going abroad to study also traveled with the Iwakura Mission.

examples.japanese: {岩倉使節団|いわくらしせつだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}かされた。
examples.english: The knowledge the Iwakura Mission brought back was put to use in the Meiji government's modernization policies.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Led by {岩倉具視|いわくらともみ}, with government leaders such as {大久保利通|おおくぼとしみち}, {木戸孝允|きどたかよし} and ⟦{伊藤博文|いとうひろぶみ}→伊藤博文：31134_itouhirobumi⟧
- Its first aim, revising the unequal treaties, failed, so it spent most of its time studying Western institutions
- More than forty students went with it, among them the young {津田梅子|つだうめこ}, later a pioneer of women's education
